title: Bill Murray makes surprise appearance at Bill Murray movie marathon in New Bedford
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Bill Murray made a surprise appearance at a Bill Murray movie marathon in New Bedford on August 3, 2026.
He interacted with 400 attendees, answering questions and sharing personal insights, like his favorite film 'Broken Flowers'.
The marathon is part of a series in August exploring Murray's films, with hopes he might attend another showing.

title: State Police trooper suspended after allegedly stealing Bobcat excavator
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Massachusetts Trooper Joseph Franklin faces felony charges for larceny over $1,200 and witness intimidation related to a Bobcat theft.
The POST Commission suspended Franklin's law enforcement certification citing potential criminal conduct; he remains suspended with pay since July 9.
Franklin alleged a tree removal dispute led him to hold a Bobcat as collateral, but police considered it larceny; court appearance is pending.

title: All the new movies and TV shows streaming now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 premieres on August 5, 2026, on Apple TV, featuring Jason Sudeikis coaching a women's team.
'Reacher' Season 4 featuring Alan Ritchson returns to Prime Video on August 14, 2026.
Netflix debuts 'The Whisper Man' starring Robert De Niro, Michelle Monaghan, and Adam Scott on August 29, 2026.

title: A longtime 7News reporter is signing off
author: John Waller
bullets: Kimberly Bookman announced her departure from 7News after 12 years, her longest tenure at a single job.
Bookman, a Needham native, joined 7News in 2014 with prior experience in New Hampshire, Baltimore, and South Carolina.
Though Bookman didn't specify her next role, she confirmed plans to remain in the local area.

title: Cambridge man dies after being pulled from waters off Martha’s Vineyard
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Kevin Foster, 55, from Cambridge died after a swimming incident off Martha's Vineyard on July 31.
The incident occurred at Long Point Wildlife Refuge, West Tisbury; no lifeguards were present.
A GoFundMe for the Foster family has raised over $74,000 following Kevin's death.

title: Drake Maye runs through scouting report of Patriots’ crowded receiver room
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye discusses New England Patriots' receiver depth, noting each brings value, as seven wideouts compete for starting roles.
Maye praised A.J. Brown for setting the tone and highlighted Romeo Doubs' improvements in learning the new offense.
Receivers like DeMario Douglas and Kayshon Boutte show promising growth, expected to be crucial in Patriots' offensive plays.

title: Why one MLB analyst labeled Red Sox trade for Adley Rutschman as a ‘wild overpay on the face of it’
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Red Sox acquire catcher Adley Rutschman from Orioles for Carlos Narváez and prospects Anthony Eyanson, Kyson Witherspoon, Enddy Azocar.
ESPN analyst Kiley McDaniel criticizes the trade as a 'wild overpay,' questioning the high price Boston paid for Rutschman.
Boston sought Rutschman to boost offense after Curtis Mead's injury, despite Red Sox being below league average in offensive stats.

title: David Sedaris on Duolingo, death, and dressing like a priest
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: David Sedaris begins his 'Lobster Roll Tour' in New England, promoting his new essay collection 'The Land and Its People'.
Sedaris discusses overcoming a Duolingo game addiction he humorously explores in his latest essays.
His new work includes personal reflections, covering themes like death, family relationships, and his secret marriage.

title: John C. Reilly jumped on stage to sing at a Boston dive bar
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: John C. Reilly performed at Tavern at the End of the World, a dive bar near Somerville, singing with local band Bosstown Heavy.
Reilly is known for joining live musical performances, including appearances at Newport Folk Festival with artists like Nathaniel Rateliff.
After performing, Reilly visited Kelly's Diner in Somerville, where the owner's daughter praised his cool demeanor.

title: Mass. woman found after going missing for 27 hours in N.H. woods
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Megan Kelley, 39, from Fall River, was found after going missing for 27 hours in New Hampshire woods.
Kelley was discovered by hikers on an access road near mountain biking trails in Gorham, according to officials.
She was transported to Androscoggin Valley Hospital with no life-threatening injuries; circumstances of her disappearance remain unclear.
